_readme: Per-game fixes the Xbox (WinGDK) build of a game needs before its mods work. Files are written relative to the game's Content folder and put back whenever they go missing (the CurseForge app replaces the ue4ss folder when it installs a mod). A fixpacks.json next to XboxModBridge.exe adds to or replaces these by name.

packs.name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds - UE4SS signature for the Xbox build
